summary: 0.2.5 improves CEE compatibility and mixed-mod wiring and measurement tools. API 1.0.0 and existing saves stay compatible.
changes: Support CEE 1.1.4 while retaining 1.1.3, including correct variac voltage and heating readings.
Reveal CEE panels for PG/Gauged wires and PG multimeters, and highlight and select CEE terminals without bypassing walls or reach limits.
Prevent wiring and measurement clicks from operating CEE controls, including fuse-holder switches, while keeping normal controls, copper insertion and fuse repairs.
installation: Use Minecraft 1.21.1, Java 21, Create 6.0.10-280, CEE 1.1.3 or 1.1.4, Power Grid 0.6.2 and Architectury 13.0.8. Focused dev.112 checks used Windows and NeoForge 21.1.248; complete release acceptance is pending. Match server and client mod versions.
optional_installation: Pinout editions also require CC:Tweaked 1.120.2 and CC;CPG: Pinout 0.2.1.
